en: A monochrome vintage postcard showing a landscaped park with curved paths, benches, ornate lampposts, and a large monument at the center. The monument consists of a rocky pedestal crowned by a winged angel-like figure holding a cross, known as the Russalka monument. In the background are pavilion-style wooden buildings and trees. People sit on benches and stroll through the park, giving the scene an early-20th‑century atmosphere. The captions on the front identify the place and the monument.
